verses.sloka: वसिष्ठस्तु तदा राममुक्त्वा राजपुरोऺहित: ।अब्रवीद्धर्मसंयुक्तं पुनरेवापरं वच: ॥ २.१११.१॥
verses.transliteration: vasiṣṭhastu tadā rāmamuktvā rājapuroऺhita: ।abravīddharmasaṁyuktaṁ punarevāparaṁ vaca: ॥ 2.111.1॥

translations.english: Vasistha, the family priest, continued to speak to Rama on righteousness.

verses.sloka: पुरुषस्येह जातस्य भवन्ति गुरवस्त्रय: ।आचार्य्यश्चैव काकुत्स्थ पिता माता च राघव ॥ २.१११.२॥
verses.transliteration: puruṣasyeha jātasya bhavanti guravastraya: ।ācāryyaścaiva kākutstha pitā mātā ca rāghava ॥ 2.111.2॥

translations.english: Every man born has three preceptors. They are his teacher, father and mother.
translations.hindi: हे भरत ! तुम नृपोत्तम महाराज दशरथ जो से, कंकेयो के गर्भ से उत्पन्न हुए हो, प्रत: जो तुम कहते हो सो सब ठोक है

verses.sloka: पिता ह्येनं जनयति पुरुषं पुरुषर्षभ ।प्रज्ञां ददाति चाचार्यस्तस्मात्स गुरुरुच्यते ॥ २.१११.३॥
verses.transliteration: pitā hyenaṁ janayati puruṣaṁ puruṣarṣabha ।prajñāṁ dadāti cācāryastasmātsa gururucyate ॥ 2.111.3॥

translations.english: O best of men, the father brings forth a son. The teacher imparts him wisdom. Therefore, the teacher is considered superior.
translations.hindi: पूर्वकाल सें जव हमारे पिता दशरथ जी तुम्हारी माता कंकेयो से विवाह करने गये थे तब तुम्हारे नाना से उन्होंने यह प्रतिज्ञा की थो कि, तुम्हारी बेटी के गर्भ से जो पुत्र उत्पन्न होगा वही मेरे राज्यसिहासन पर खेठेगा

verses.sloka: सो ऽहं ते पितुराचार्य्यस्तव चैव परन्तप ।मम त्वं वचनं कुर्वन् नातिवर्त्ते: सताङ्गतिम् ॥ २.१११.४॥
verses.transliteration: so 'haṁ te piturācāryyastava caiva parantapa ।mama tvaṁ vacanaṁ kurvan nātivartte: satāṅgatim ॥ 2.111.4॥

translations.english: I was preceptor to your father and also to you. O destroyer of foes, by following my words, you will not transgress the path of the virtuous.
translations.hindi: टिप्पणी--महाराज दशरथ का ऐसी प्रतिज्ञा करना भ्रनुचित न था । क्योंकि कैकेयी के साथ उनका विवाह ढलती उमर में हुआ था । अन्य रातियों के साथ बहुत दिनों रह कर, वे पुत्रोत्पन्न होने से निराश हो चुके थे । कैकेयी के साथ विवाह पुत्र की कामना ही से किया था । घतः उनका एसी प्रतिज्ञा करना ठीक ही था । १ ग्रभिसत्कृतः--भरतेन स्तोत्रादिना सम्यगमिपूजितः। (गोऽ) श्रयोध्याकाण्छे | यदि यहाँ यह कोई कहे कि, जब महाराज कँकेयी के गर्भ से उत्पन्नः सन्ताने ही को राज्य देने के लिए प्रतिज्ञाबद्ध हो चुके थे, तब श्रीराम को युवराजपद देने की तैयारियाँ उन्होंने क्यों कीं ? इस शङ्का का समाधान स्मृतिकारों के इस वचन से होता है-- “उद्वाहकाले रतिसंप्रयोगे प्राणव्यये सर्वधनापहारे । विप्रस्य चार्थेऽप्यनृतंवदेयुः पञ्चानृतान्याहुरपातकानिं ॥” [इसके अतिरिक्त महाराज अपने कुल की परम्परागत प्रथा के प्रनुसार ` ज्येष्ठ राजकुमार को राजसिहासन देने के लिए भी बाध्य थे । यदि वे इस प्रथा के विरुद्ध कार्य करते, तो प्रजा उनके. इस श्रनुचित कार्य का घोर विरोध करती और उनकी तिन्दा करती जैसे कि प्रजा ने श्री राम के वनवास के समय किया भी था। फिर एक बात झौर भी है । जिस समय कैकेयी के पिता के साथ दशरथ ने उक्त प्रतिज्ञा की थी उस समय उन्हें यह ज्ञान न था कि उनकी उन रानियों से पुत्र होंगे जिनके इतने दीर्घकाल तक नहीं हुए थे ।] देवासुरे च संग्रामे जनन्ये तव पार्थिवः । सम्प्रहृष्टो ददौ राजा वरमाराधितः प्रभुः

verses.sloka: इमा हि ते परिषद: श्रेणयश्च द्विजास्तथा ।एषु तात चरन् धर्मं नातिवर्त्ते: सताङ्गतिम् ॥ २.१११.५॥
verses.transliteration: imā hi te pariṣada: śreṇayaśca dvijāstathā ।eṣu tāta caran dharmaṁ nātivartte: satāṅgatim ॥ 2.111.5॥

translations.english: All these learned men, guilds of merchants and the twiceborn (brahmins) of this assembly are your men. By fulfilling your duty towards them, you will never swerve from the path of the virtuous.
translations.hindi: इसके भ्रतिरिक्त, देवासुर संग्राम में भो तुम्हारी माता के उपकार से सन्तुष्ट हो, पिता जी ने उन्हें दो वरदान देने कहे थे 0४॥॥ ततः सा सम्प्रतिश्राव्य तव माता यशस्विनी । ` श्रयाचत नरश्रेष्ठं हो वरो वरवणिनी

verses.sloka: वृद्धाया धर्मशीलाया मातुर्नार्हस्यवर्त्तितुम् ।अस्यास्तु वचनं कुर्वन् नातिवर्त्ते: सताङ्गतिम् ॥ २.१११.६॥
verses.transliteration: vṛddhāyā dharmaśīlāyā māturnārhasyavarttitum ।asyāstu vacanaṁ kurvan nātivartte: satāṅgatim ॥ 2.111.6॥

translations.english: Here is your aged and righteous mother. It does not behove you to deny your service to her. By obeying her, you will never deviate from the path of the virtuous.

verses.sloka: भरतस्य वच: कुर्वन् याचमानस्य राघव ।आत्मानं नातिवर्त्तेस्त्वं सत्यधर्मपराक्रम ॥ २.१११.७॥
verses.transliteration: bharatasya vaca: kurvan yācamānasya rāghava ।ātmānaṁ nātivarttestvaṁ satyadharmaparākrama ॥ 2.111.7॥

translations.english: O scion of the Raghus whose strength springs from truth and righteousness, if you accede to the prayers of Bharata, you will not ignore the call of your soul.

verses.sloka: एवं मधुरमुक्तस्तु गुरुणा राघव: स्वयम् ।प्रत्युवाच समासीनं वसिष्ठं पुरुषर्षभ: ॥ २.१११.८॥
verses.transliteration: evaṁ madhuramuktastu guruṇā rāghava: svayam ।pratyuvāca samāsīnaṁ vasiṣṭhaṁ puruṣarṣabha: ॥ 2.111.8॥

translations.english: When Rama, the best of men, was advised personally by Vasistha, the preceptor, with sweet words, he replied to him who was sitting beside him:

verses.sloka: यन्मातापितरौ वृत्तं तनये कुरुत: सदा ।न सुप्रतिकरं तत्तु मात्रा पित्रा च यत्कृतम् ॥ २.१११.९॥
verses.transliteration: yanmātāpitarau vṛttaṁ tanaye kuruta: sadā ।na supratikaraṁ tattu mātrā pitrā ca yatkṛtam ॥ 2.111.9॥

translations.english: The course of action the parents always adopt in respect of their son, the benefits they confer on him according to their resources, the way they lull him to sleep and clothe him, the affectionate words they always speak to him and the way they bring him up all these cannot be repaid.

verses.sloka: यथाशक्ति प्रदानेन स्नापनोच्छादनेन च ।नित्यं च प्रियवादेन तथा संवर्द्धनेन च ॥ २.१११.१०॥
verses.transliteration: yathāśakti pradānena snāpanocchādanena ca ।nityaṁ ca priyavādena tathā saṁvarddhanena ca ॥ 2.111.10॥

translations.english: The course of action the parents always adopt in respect of their son, the benefits they confer on him according to their resources, the way they lull him to sleep and clothe him, the affectionate words they always speak to him and the way they bring him up all these cannot be repaid.
translations.hindi: टिप्पणी-यहाँ श्रीराम ने भरत को “भवान” कहा है । यह इस लिए कि वे उनको अयोध्या का न्यायतः अधिकारी समझते हें।] ऋणान्‌ मौचय राजानं मत्कृते भरत प्रशुम्‌ । ० “२ 6०० ० [oN पितरं चापि धमज्ञं मातरं चाभिनन्दय

verses.sloka: स हि राजा जनयिता पिता दशरथो मम ।आज्ञातं यन्मया तस्य न तन्मिथ्या भविष्यति ॥ २.१११.११॥
verses.transliteration: sa hi rājā janayitā pitā daśaratho mama ।ājñātaṁ yanmayā tasya na tanmithyā bhaviṣyati ॥ 2.111.11॥

translations.english: King Dasaratha is my father who begot me. The promise I made him shall not prove false.
translations.hindi: हे तात ! सुना है कि, पूवकाल में गय नाम छे एक थशश्यी राजा गया प्रदेश में यज्ञ करते थे । उन्होंने पितरों से यह वाक्य कहा था कि,

verses.sloka: एवमुक्तस्तु रामेण भरत: प्रत्यनन्तरम् ।उवाच परमोदार: सूतं परमदुर्मना: ॥ २.१११.१२॥
verses.transliteration: evamuktastu rāmeṇa bharata: pratyanantaram ।uvāca paramodāra: sūtaṁ paramadurmanā: ॥ 2.111.12॥

translations.english: Having been addressed by Rama in this way, Bharata of great generosity, in extreme distress, addressing the charioteer who was standing nearby said:

verses.sloka: इह मे स्थण्डिले शीघ्रं कुशानास्तर सारथे ।आर्य्यं प्रत्युपवेक्ष्यामि यावन्मे न प्रसीदति ॥ २.१११.१३॥
verses.transliteration: iha me sthaṇḍile śīghraṁ kuśānāstara sārathe ।āryyaṁ pratyupavekṣyāmi yāvanme na prasīdati ॥ 2.111.13॥

translations.english: O charioteer, quickly spread kusa grass on the bare ground. Until my esteemed brother shows his grace, I shall lie down here -- waiting.

verses.sloka: अनाहारो निरालोको धनहीनो यथा द्विज: ।शेष्ये पुरस्तात् शालाया यावन्न प्रतियास्यति ॥ २.१११.१४॥
verses.transliteration: anāhāro nirāloko dhanahīno yathā dvija: ।śeṣye purastāt śālāyā yāvanna pratiyāsyati ॥ 2.111.14॥

translations.english: Like a poor brahmin, starving, my face muffled, I shall lie down in front of the hut until he agrees to return.

verses.sloka: स तु राममवेक्षन्तं सुमन्त्रं प्रेक्ष्य दुर्मना: ।कुशोत्तरमुपस्थाप्य भूमावेवास्तरत् स्वयम् ॥ २.१११.१५॥
verses.transliteration: sa tu rāmamavekṣantaṁ sumantraṁ prekṣya durmanā: ।kuśottaramupasthāpya bhūmāvevāstarat svayam ॥ 2.111.15॥

translations.english: Bharata was mentally disturbed saw Sumantra waiting for Rama's order. Then he himself brought a heap of kusa grass and spread it on the ground.

verses.sloka: तमुवाच महातेजा रामो राजर्षिसत्तम: ।किं मां भरत कुर्वाणं तात प्रत्युपवेक्ष्यसि ॥ २.१११.१६॥
verses.transliteration: tamuvāca mahātejā rāmo rājarṣisattama: ।kiṁ māṁ bharata kurvāṇaṁ tāta pratyupavekṣyasi ॥ 2.111.16॥

translations.english: Rama, the foremost of royal sages and highly powerful said, 'Dear Bharata, what wrong have I done that you should prevent me by lying down in front of me?'

verses.sloka: ब्राह्मणो ह्येकपार्श्वेन नरान् रोद्धुमिहार्हति ।न तु मूर्द्धाभिषिक्तानां विधि: प्रत्युपवेशने ॥ २.१११.१७॥
verses.transliteration: brāhmaṇo hyekapārśvena narān roddhumihārhati ।na tu mūrddhābhiṣiktānāṁ vidhi: pratyupaveśane ॥ 2.111.17॥

translations.english: A brahmin alone is competent in this world to prevent a person by lying down on one side (in front of him). One who is anointed king is not permitted by (scriptural) tradition to squat in protest.

verses.sloka: उत्तिष्ठ नरशार्दूल हित्वैतद्दारुणं व्रतम् ।पुरवर्य्यामित: क्षिप्रमयोध्यां याहि राघव ॥ २.१११.१८॥
verses.transliteration: uttiṣṭha naraśārdūla hitvaitaddāruṇaṁ vratam ।puravaryyāmita: kṣipramayodhyāṁ yāhi rāghava ॥ 2.111.18॥

translations.english: O Bharata, O tiger among men, O scion of the Raghu race give up this formidable vow. Arise and quickly return to Ayodhya, the best of cities.

verses.sloka: आसीनस्त्वेव भरत: पौरजानपदं जनम् ।उवाच सर्वत: प्रेक्ष्य किमार्यं नानुशासथ ॥ २.१११.१९॥
verses.transliteration: āsīnastveva bharata: paurajānapadaṁ janam ।uvāca sarvata: prekṣya kimāryaṁ nānuśāsatha ॥ 2.111.19॥

translations.english: While remaining seated, Bharata looking all around at the inhabitants from towns and villages, questioned them 'why don't you all persuade my esteemed brother to return'.

verses.sloka: ते तमूचुर्महात्मानं पौरजानपदा जना: ।काकुत्स्थमभिजानीम: सम्यग्वदति राघव: ॥ २.१११.२०॥
verses.transliteration: te tamūcurmahātmānaṁ paurajānapadā janā: ।kākutsthamabhijānīma: samyagvadati rāghava: ॥ 2.111.20॥

translations.english: Those inhabitants from towns and villages replied to the magnanimous Bharata 'we know the scion of the Kakutha dynasty, Rama, very well. What he has said is proper'.

verses.sloka: एषो ऽपि हि महाभाग: पितुर्वचसि तिष्ठति ।अत एव न शक्ता: स्मो व्यावर्त्तयितुमञ्जसा ॥ २.१११.२१॥
verses.transliteration: eṣo 'pi hi mahābhāga: piturvacasi tiṣṭhati ।ata eva na śaktā: smo vyāvarttayitumañjasā ॥ 2.111.21॥

translations.english: Highly distinguished Rama is firmly fixed on the command of his father. That is why we are incapable of making him return quickly.

verses.sloka: तेषामाज्ञाय वचनं रामो वचनमब्रवीत् ।एवं निबोध वचनं सुहृदां धर्मचक्षुषाम् ॥ २.१११.२२॥
verses.transliteration: teṣāmājñāya vacanaṁ rāmo vacanamabravīt ।evaṁ nibodha vacanaṁ suhṛdāṁ dharmacakṣuṣām ॥ 2.111.22॥

translations.english: Having understood their words, Rama said to him, 'Listen to the words of our friends who have a righteous vision.'

verses.sloka: एतच्चैवोभयं श्रुत्वा सम्यक् सम्पश्य राघव ।उत्तिष्ठ त्वं महाबाहो मां च स्पृश तथोदकम् ॥ २.१११.२३॥
verses.transliteration: etaccaivobhayaṁ śrutvā samyak sampaśya rāghava ।uttiṣṭha tvaṁ mahābāho māṁ ca spṛśa tathodakam ॥ 2.111.23॥

translations.english: O mightyarmed son of the Raghus, you have heard both (them and me). Carefully think over. Arise. Touch me and sip water.

verses.sloka: अथोत्थाय जलं स्पृष्ट्वा भरतो वाक्यमब्रवीत् ।श्रृण्वन्तु मे परिषदो मन्त्रिण: श्रेणयस्तथा ॥ २.१११.२४॥
verses.transliteration: athotthāya jalaṁ spṛṣṭvā bharato vākyamabravīt ।śrṛṇvantu me pariṣado mantriṇa: śreṇayastathā ॥ 2.111.24॥

translations.english: Then Bharata stood up and performed achamana (sipping of water) and said 'let the assembly of learned men, counsellors and guildsmen hear me'.

verses.sloka: न याचे पितरं राज्यं नानुशासामि मातरम् ।आर्यं परमधर्मज्ञं नानुजानामि राघवम् ॥ २.१११.२५॥
verses.transliteration: na yāce pitaraṁ rājyaṁ nānuśāsāmi mātaram ।āryaṁ paramadharmajñaṁ nānujānāmi rāghavam ॥ 2.111.25॥

translations.english: I never asked my father to confer the kingdom on me. I never urged my mother to seek the kingdom for me. I never supported the exile of my esteemed brother Rama, who is supreme in the knowleldge of righteousness.

verses.sloka: यदि त्ववश्यं वस्तव्यं कर्त्तव्यं च पितुर्वच: ।अहमेव निवत्स्यामि चतुर्दश समा वने ॥ २.१११.२६॥
verses.transliteration: yadi tvavaśyaṁ vastavyaṁ karttavyaṁ ca piturvaca: ।ahameva nivatsyāmi caturdaśa samā vane ॥ 2.111.26॥

translations.english: If it is absolutely essential to live in the forest in accordance with the command of my father, I myself shall also dwell in the forest for fourteen years.

verses.sloka: धर्मात्मा तस्य तथ्येन भ्रातुर्वाक्येन विस्मित: ।उवाच राम: सम्प्रेक्ष्य पौरजानपदं जनम् ॥ २.१११.२७॥
verses.transliteration: dharmātmā tasya tathyena bhrāturvākyena vismita: ।uvāca rāma: samprekṣya paurajānapadaṁ janam ॥ 2.111.27॥

translations.english: On hearing the genuine sentiments of his brother, righteous Rama was astonished. He said to the inhabitants from towns and villages:

verses.sloka: विक्रीतमाहितं क्रीतं यत् पित्रा जीवता मम ।न तल्लोपयितुं शक्यं मया वा भरतेन वा ॥ २.१११.२८॥
verses.transliteration: vikrītamāhitaṁ krītaṁ yat pitrā jīvatā mama ।na tallopayituṁ śakyaṁ mayā vā bharatena vā ॥ 2.111.28॥

translations.english: Neither Bharata nor I can in any way annul anything which was sold, pledged or bought by my father during his lifetime.

verses.sloka: अपधिर्न मया कार्य्यो वनवासे जुगुप्सित: ।युक्तमुक्तं च कैकेय्या पित्रा मे सुकृतं कृतम् ॥ २.१११.२९॥
verses.transliteration: apadhirna mayā kāryyo vanavāse jugupsita: ।yuktamuktaṁ ca kaikeyyā pitrā me sukṛtaṁ kṛtam ॥ 2.111.29॥

translations.english: As far as living in the forest is concerned it is reprehensible to keep a subsitute for me and it shall not be done. Kaikeyi has acted rightfully and my father has taken the proper decision.

verses.sloka: जानामि भरतं क्षान्तं गुरुसत्कारकारिणम् ।सर्वमेवात्र कल्याणं सत्यसन्धे महात्मनि ॥ २.१११.३०॥
verses.transliteration: jānāmi bharataṁ kṣāntaṁ gurusatkārakāriṇam ।sarvamevātra kalyāṇaṁ satyasandhe mahātmani ॥ 2.111.30॥

translations.english: I know Bharata as a man of forbearance and one who honours elders. Everything will turn out well for this great soul wedded to truth.

verses.sloka: अनेन धर्मशीलेन वनात् प्रत्यागत: पुन: ।भ्रात्रा सह भविष्यामि पृथिव्या: पतिरुत्तम: ॥ २.१११.३१॥
verses.transliteration: anena dharmaśīlena vanāt pratyāgata: puna: ।bhrātrā saha bhaviṣyāmi pṛthivyā: patiruttama: ॥ 2.111.31॥

translations.english: On returning from the forest, I shall become the supreme lord of this earth along with this virtuous brother.

verses.sloka: वृतो राजा हि कैकेय्या मया तद्वचनं कृतम् ।अनृतन्मोचयानेन पितरं तं महीपतिम् ॥ २.१११.३२ ॥
verses.transliteration: vṛto rājā hi kaikeyyā mayā tadvacanaṁ kṛtam ।anṛtanmocayānena pitaraṁ taṁ mahīpatim ॥ 2.111.32 ॥

translations.english: The king (Dasaratha) was solicited by Kaikeyi and I shall abide. Therefore, you also release the lord of the earth, our father from the charge of falsehood. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये अयोध्याकाण्डे एकादशोत्तरशततमस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the hundredeleventh sarga in Ayodhyakanda of the holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
